selection_policy: Manually curated research priorities, not predicted response probabilities. Conditional screens require measured pathway/phenotype and matched-normal safety gates. Regulatory approval elsewhere never establishes MVA efficacy. Final scientific/exposure review demotes hydroxychloroquine to reserve; one priority conditional screen is not a clinical recommendation.

candidates.name: Everolimus
candidates.approved_use: Specified TSC-associated SEGA/seizure indications for the reviewed oral-suspension product; not MVA or RMS.
candidates.target_direction: Inhibit mTORC1 via FKBP12; not BUBR1 replacement.
candidates.bridge: Test whether this genotype creates measurable mTORC1 excess, then whether attenuation improves cellular function.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Could impair growth, immune defence or tissue repair; renal and mucosal toxicity warrant particular scrutiny.
candidates.exposure_gap: TSC whole-blood trough 5-15 ng/mL converts to 5.2-15.7 nM, not free culture exposure. Pediatric combination PK/PD does not establish this genotype's functional threshold or normal-cell margin. See track2-exposure.json.
candidates.falsifier: No excess mTORC1 activity, or target suppression without functional improvement, or injury to matched deficient non-cancer cells.
candidates.next_test: Only retained priority: phenotype-first mTORC1 test. Do not advance drug exposure if excess activity is absent; require functional rescue, tumour-context compatibility and matched-normal safety, not merely phospho-S6 suppression.

candidates.name: Hydroxychloroquine
candidates.approved_use: Malaria and specified adult autoimmune indications; not MVA or RMS.
candidates.target_direction: Disrupt lysosomal function/autophagic flux; a tumour-killing hypothesis, not constitutional repair.
candidates.bridge: Reserve lysosomal-dependence hypothesis after final review: closest RMS studies use CQ, bafilomycin or Lys05; these do not validate HCQ or its combination with everolimus.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Nonmalignant aneuploid cells may be sensitive too; muscle/nerve, renal, retinal and cardiac toxicity are explicit concerns.
candidates.exposure_gap: No HCQ RMS functional threshold paired with tolerated free tumour exposure and deficient-normal safety. Model-derived blood/PBMC thresholds and predicted lysosomal accumulation cannot supply that bridge.
candidates.falsifier: Tumour effect occurs only above relevant exposure or matched non-cancer BUB1B-deficient cells are equally or more sensitive.
candidates.next_test: Do not co-prioritize with everolimus. Reopen only after direct HCQ tumour-versus-deficient-normal evidence at measured exposure, with orthogonal flux and death endpoints; no assumed rapalog synergy.

candidates.name: Temsirolimus
candidates.approved_use: Advanced renal cell carcinoma; not MVA or RMS.
candidates.target_direction: Inhibit mTOR signalling via FKBP12; oncology comparator for the same pathway class.
candidates.bridge: RMS trial experience gives a clinical evidence benchmark against which novel genotype-specific claims must be judged.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Renal failure, immunosuppression, myelosuppression, mucosal and metabolic toxicity; concurrent treatment is unknown.
candidates.exposure_gap: Active metabolite and combined-regimen exposure matter; no BUB1B-selective margin established.
candidates.falsifier: No advantage over a matched backbone/control at relevant exposure; repeat of the negative unselected phase III result.
candidates.next_test: Use as a benchmark only, not a second independent repurposing win or evidence that everolimus works.

candidates.name: Sodium phenylbutyrate
candidates.approved_use: Adjunctive chronic management of specified urea-cycle disorders.
candidates.target_direction: General chemical-chaperone/ER-stress hypothesis; not a demonstrated BUBR1 binder.
candidates.bridge: Consider only if Asn1002Lys is experimentally shown to be unstable yet functionally rescuable.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Sodium load, renal elimination and nutrition/tolerance issues; stabilizing protein need not restore function.
candidates.exposure_gap: No BUBR1 concentration-response, binding or functional rescue evidence identified.
candidates.falsifier: Variant abundance is normal, protein is intrinsically dysfunctional, or apparent abundance rescue fails chromosome-segregation assays.
candidates.next_test: Characterize missense protein first; only then consider a low-priority repurposing screen.

candidates.name: Bortezomib
candidates.target_direction: Inhibit proteasomal degradation; do not label global turnover blockade as precise BUBR1 stabilization.
candidates.bridge: Aneuploid proteotoxic burden could confer vulnerability, but selective benefit is unshown.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Neuropathy, cytopenias and disruption of normal protein turnover; compromised non-cancer cells may be harmed.
candidates.exposure_gap: Low-nanomolar nominal culture activity and serum-Cmax comparisons are preliminary. A 72-hour culture exposure is not a sustained clinical peak or a matched-normal window.
candidates.falsifier: Broad toxicity without a tumour-versus-deficient-normal margin or failure at attainable tumour exposure.
candidates.next_test: Do not advance ahead of stronger hypotheses without new selective-dependency evidence.

candidates.name: Metformin
candidates.approved_use: Type 2 diabetes in adults and specified pediatric population.
candidates.target_direction: Metabolic/AMPK-mTOR hypothesis; not interchangeable with AICAR.
candidates.bridge: A pediatric metformin/VIT trial included an RMS partial response, but no VIT-alone comparison isolates metformin's contribution; AICAR is a different compound.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Renal-function-dependent lactic-acidosis risk and nutritional/GI burden; high-dose cell genotoxicity cannot be ignored or extrapolated directly to patients.
candidates.exposure_gap: Small pediatric combination PK cohort reports 404 ng/mL average steady-state concentration with unclear blood/plasma terminology. Millimolar culture claims remain unbridged; neither a response nor a nominal/plasma ratio is a selective margin.
candidates.falsifier: Activity disappears within a justified exposure envelope or is nonspecific genotoxicity.
candidates.next_test: Retain as an exposure-confounding example, not a lead based on low price or familiarity.

candidates.name: Gentamicin
candidates.approved_use: Specified bacterial infections, not chronic nonsense-variant rescue.
candidates.bridge: Leu737Ter introduces a stop, but readthrough depends on transcript survival, stop context and the inserted amino acid. The cited PTC124 paper supports the general concept, not gentamicin-specific BUB1B rescue.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Nephrotoxicity, potentially irreversible ototoxicity and neuromuscular effects make empiric chronic use unjustified.
candidates.exposure_gap: No endogenous BUB1B functional readthrough window established.
candidates.falsifier: No endogenous full-length functional protein, or toxicity at concentrations needed for readthrough.
candidates.next_test: If readthrough is studied academically, demand orthogonal endogenous-protein assays; not a clinical candidate here.

candidates.name: Ataluren
candidates.approved_use: Former conditional DMD authorisation; EU non-renewal in 2025.
candidates.target_direction: Premature-stop readthrough hypothesis, not restoration of missing transcript.
candidates.bridge: Nonsense-variant class motivates consideration, not evidence for this gene.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Unproven benefit and genotype-specific translation fidelity; no patient-specific safety assessment.
candidates.exposure_gap: No BUB1B response evidence or verified current approved-use route in the reviewed jurisdiction.
candidates.falsifier: Fails regulatory gate or endogenous BUBR1 functional rescue.
candidates.next_test: Exclude from approved-drug shortlist; retain the negative regulatory record.

candidates.name: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN)
candidates.approved_use: No medicinal approval verified in this review; supplement status is not drug approval.
candidates.bridge: Published mouse/cell abundance findings nominate a mechanism, not an approved repurposed treatment.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Could affect many NAD-dependent processes; effects on tumour and non-tumour cells may differ.
candidates.exposure_gap: No human MVA PK-PD or functional rescue; NMN abundance data must not be called an NMN lifespan trial.
candidates.falsifier: No regulatory eligibility or improved abundance without improved function.
candidates.next_test: Mechanistic comparator only if a laboratory pursues SIRT2 biology; no supplement recommendation.

candidates.name: Nicotinamide
candidates.approved_use: A specific medicinal product and jurisdiction were not verified for this proposal.
candidates.target_direction: Context-dependent NAD precursor and sirtuin inhibition; not the same intervention as NMN.
candidates.bridge: A generic vitamin/NAD argument is insufficient and can have the wrong direction.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: BubR1 abundance fell in high-concentration cell assays; ordinary nutrient intake is not being judged here.
candidates.exposure_gap: No dose/context-resolved rescue evidence; high cell concentrations cannot be directly extrapolated clinically.
candidates.falsifier: Reduced BubR1 or no functional benefit in the relevant model.
candidates.next_test: Reject as a generic rescue claim; do not recommend changing dietary intake.

candidates.name: Dasatinib plus quercetin
candidates.approved_use: The proposed senolytic combination is not verified as an approved medicine/indication; individual-drug status would not prove combination benefit.
candidates.target_direction: Eliminate selected senescent cells, not repair chromosome segregation.
candidates.bridge: INK-ATTAC mouse findings motivate senescence research but not this drug combination.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Removing growth-arrested cells may impair developing tissue or remove tumour-suppressive barriers; requires direct tests.
candidates.exposure_gap: No pediatric BUB1B-MVA therapeutic window or combination equivalence to genetic ablation.
candidates.falsifier: Failure to reproduce selective benefit or impairment of normal-tissue function.
candidates.next_test: Do not equate anti-ageing mouse evidence with pediatric treatment.

candidates.name: Bubristatin (BRT-1)
candidates.approved_use: Research compound, no medicinal approval verified.
candidates.bridge: Target association alone does not imply that inhibition repairs loss of checkpoint function.
candidates.normal_tissue_risk: Potentially worsens checkpoint/attachment function in already compromised non-cancer cells.
candidates.exposure_gap: No approved formulation, human MVA exposure or rescue evidence.
candidates.falsifier: Wrong direction for constitutional repair or lack of tumour-versus-normal selectivity.
candidates.next_test: Research control only; do not perform docking and relabel binding as therapeutic rescue.
